translations.idiomatic: If we do not campaign south, we should move the capital here—what do the princes and dukes think?

sentences.zh: 欲遷者左，不欲者右。」

translations.literal: Those who wish to move, stand to the left; those who do not, to the right."
translations.idiomatic: Those who wish to move, stand to the left; those who do not, to the right.

sentences.zh: 安定王休等相帥如右。

translations.literal: Prince Xiu of Anding and the others led one another to the right.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiu of Anding and the others led one another to the right.

sentences.zh: 南安王楨進曰：「『成大功者不謀於眾。』

translations.literal: Prince Zhen of Nan'an stepped forward and said: "'He who would achieve great things does not consult the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhen of Nan'an stepped forward and said, "'He who would achieve great things does not consult the multitude.

sentences.zh: 今陛下苟輟南伐之謀，遷都洛邑，此臣等之願，蒼生之幸也。」

translations.literal: If Your Majesty would now abandon the plan for a southern campaign and move the capital to Luoyang, that is the wish of your servants—and the fortune of the people."
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty would now abandon the plan for a southern campaign and move the capital to Luoyang, that is the wish of your servants—and the fortune of the people.'

sentences.zh: 群臣皆呼萬歲。

translations.literal: All the ministers cried "Long live the emperor!"
translations.idiomatic: All the ministers cried, "Long live the emperor!"

sentences.zh: 時舊人雖不願內徙，而憚於南伐，無敢言者；

translations.literal: At the time the old guard, though unwilling to move inward, feared the southern campaign and none dared speak;
translations.idiomatic: At the time the northerners, though unwilling to move south, feared the southern campaign and none dared object;

sentences.zh: 遂定遷都之計。

translations.literal: and so the plan to move the capital was settled.
translations.idiomatic: and so the plan to move the capital was settled.

sentences.zh: 李沖言於上曰：「陛下將定鼎洛邑，宗廟宮室，非可馬上行遊以待之。

translations.literal: Li Chong said to the emperor: "Your Majesty intends to establish the capital at Luoyang; the ancestral temples and palaces cannot be awaited while touring on horseback.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chong said to the emperor, "Your Majesty intends to establish the capital at Luoyang; the ancestral temples and palaces cannot be readied while you travel on horseback.

sentences.zh: 願陛下暫還代都，俟群臣經營畢功，然後備文物、鳴和鸞而臨之。」

translations.literal: I beg Your Majesty to return for the time being to the capital at Dai, wait until the ministers have finished their preparations, and then, with full regalia and the harmon and phoenix bells sounding, take up residence there."
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to return for the time being to the capital at Dai, wait until the ministers have finished their preparations, and then enter Luoyang with full ceremonial regalia and the imperial bells ringing.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「朕將巡省州郡，至鄴小停，春首即還，未宜歸北。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "I shall tour and inspect the provinces and commanderies, pause briefly at Ye, and return at the beginning of spring—it is not yet fitting to go back north."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "I shall tour and inspect the provinces and commanderies, pause briefly at Ye, and return at the beginning of spring—it is not yet fitting to go back north.

sentences.zh: 乃遣任城王澄還平城，諭留司百官以遷都之事，曰：「今日真所謂革也。

translations.literal: He then sent Prince Cheng of Rencheng back to Pingcheng to instruct the officials left behind in the Northern Capital concerning the move of the capital, saying: "Today this is truly what is called revolution.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent Prince Cheng of Rencheng back to Pingcheng to instruct the officials left behind in the Northern Capital concerning the move of the capital, saying, "Today this is truly revolution itself.

sentences.zh: 王其勉之！」

translations.literal: Prince, exert yourself!"
translations.idiomatic: Prince, exert yourself!

sentences.zh: 帝以群臣意多異同，謂衛尉卿、鎮南將軍於烈曰：「卿意如何？」

translations.literal: Since the ministers' views differed greatly, the emperor asked Commander of the Guard and General Who Guards the South Yu Lie: "What is your view?"
translations.idiomatic: Since the ministers' views differed greatly, the emperor asked Commander of the Guard and General Who Guards the South Yu Lie, "What is your view?

sentences.zh: 烈曰：「陛下聖略淵遠，非愚淺所測。

translations.literal: Lie said: "Your Majesty's sacred design is profound and far-reaching—beyond what the dull and shallow can fathom.
translations.idiomatic: Lie said, "Your Majesty's sacred design is profound and far-reaching—beyond what the dull and shallow can fathom.

sentences.zh: 若隱心而言，樂遷之與戀舊，適中半耳。」

translations.literal: If I speak from the heart, those who rejoice in the move and those who cling to the old are about evenly divided."
translations.idiomatic: If I speak from the heart, those who welcome the move and those who cling to the old are about evenly divided.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「卿既不唱異，即是肯同，深感不言之益。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Since you do not lead the dissent, that is agreement; I deeply feel the benefit of your not speaking out."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Since you do not lead the opposition, that is support enough. I am grateful for your restraint.

sentences.zh: 使還鎮平城，曰：「留台庶政，一以相委。」

translations.literal: He sent him back to garrison Pingcheng, saying: "All routine affairs of the Northern Capital—I entrust them entirely to you."
translations.idiomatic: He sent him back to garrison Pingcheng, saying, "All routine affairs of the Northern Capital—I entrust them entirely to you.

sentences.zh: 烈，栗磾之孫也。

translations.literal: Lie was the grandson of Yu Lidi.
translations.idiomatic: Lie was the grandson of Yu Lidi.

sentences.zh: 先是，北地民支酉聚眾數千，起兵於長安城北石山，遣使告梁州刺史陰智伯，秦州民王廣亦起兵應之，攻執魏刺史劉藻，秦、雍間七州民皆響震，眾至十萬，各守堡壁以待齊救。

translations.literal: Earlier, Zhi You of the Northern Lands gathered several thousand men and raised troops at Stone Mountain north of Chang'an, sending envoys to inform Governor of Liang Province Yin Zhibo; Wang Guang of Qin Province also raised troops in response, attacked and seized Wei Governor Liu Zao, and the people of the seven provinces between Qin and Yong all echoed the uprising until the force reached one hundred thousand; each held fortified walls and awaited Qi relief.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Zhi You of the Northern Lands gathered several thousand men and raised troops at Stone Mountain north of Chang'an, sending envoys to inform Governor of Liang Province Yin Zhibo; Wang Guang of Qin Province also rose in response, attacked and seized the Wei governor Liu Zao, and the people of the seven provinces between Qin and Yong all echoed the uprising until the force reached one hundred thousand; each held fortified walls and awaited relief from Qi.

sentences.zh: 魏河南王干引兵擊之，干兵大敗；

translations.literal: Prince Gan of Henan of Wei led troops to attack them, and Gan's army was utterly defeated;
translations.idiomatic: Prince Gan of Henan of Wei led troops to attack them, and Gan's army was utterly defeated;

sentences.zh: 支酉進至咸陽北濁谷，穆亮與戰，又敗；

translations.literal: Zhi You advanced to Turbid Valley north of Xianyang; Mu Liang fought him and was again defeated;
translations.idiomatic: Zhi You advanced to Turbid Valley north of Xianyang; Mu Liang fought him and was again defeated;

sentences.zh: 陰智伯遣軍主席德仁等將兵數千與相應接。

translations.literal: Yin Zhibo sent the army commander Xie Deren and others to lead several thousand troops to join and support them.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Zhibo sent the army commander Xie Deren and others to lead several thousand troops to join and support them.

sentences.zh: 酉等進向長安，盧淵、薛胤等拒擊，大破之，降者數萬口。

translations.literal: You and the others advanced toward Chang'an; Lu Yuan, Xue Yin, and others repulsed and attacked them, inflicting a great defeat, and those who surrendered numbered tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: You and the others advanced toward Chang'an; Lu Yuan, Xue Yin, and others repulsed and attacked them, inflicting a great defeat, and tens of thousands surrendered.

sentences.zh: 淵唯誅首惡，餘悉不問，獲酉、廣，並斬之。

translations.literal: Lu Yuan executed only the ringleaders and questioned none of the rest; capturing You and Guang, he beheaded them both.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yuan executed only the ringleaders and questioned none of the rest; capturing You and Guang, he beheaded them both.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，戊寅朔，魏主如金墉城，征穆亮，使與尚書李沖、將作大匠董爾經營洛都。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day of the month wuyin, the Wei emperor went to Jinyong City, recalled Mu Liang, and had him together with Chief Secretary Li Chong and Master of Works Dong Er oversee the construction of the Luoyang capital.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day wuyin, the Wei emperor went to Jinyong City, recalled Mu Liang, and had him together with Chief Secretary Li Chong and Master of Works Dong Er oversee the construction of the Luoyang capital.

sentences.zh: 己卯，如河南城；

translations.literal: On jimao he went to Henan City;
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao he went to Henan City;

sentences.zh: 乙酉，如豫州；

translations.literal: On yiyou he went to Yu Province;
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou he went to Yu Province;

sentences.zh: 癸巳，捨於石濟。

translations.literal: On guisi he lodged at Shiji.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi he lodged at Shiji.

sentences.zh: 乙未，魏解嚴，設壇於滑台城東，告行廟以遷都之意。

translations.literal: On yiwei Wei lifted martial law, set up an altar east of Huatai City, and informed the traveling temple of the intent to move the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei Wei lifted martial law, set up an altar east of Huatai City, and informed the traveling temple of the intent to move the capital.

sentences.zh: 大赦。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 起滑台宮。

translations.literal: The Huatai Palace was built.
translations.idiomatic: The Huatai Palace was built.

sentences.zh: 任城王澄至平城，眾始聞遷都，莫不驚駭。

translations.literal: When Prince Cheng of Rencheng reached Pingcheng, the people first heard of the move of the capital and all were startled and dismayed.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Cheng of Rencheng reached Pingcheng, the people first heard of the move of the capital and all were startled and dismayed.

sentences.zh: 澄援引古今，徐以曉之，眾乃開伏。

translations.literal: Cheng cited examples from past and present and gradually explained to them; the crowd then opened up and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng cited examples from past and present and gradually explained to them; the crowd then opened up and submitted.

sentences.zh: 澄還報於滑台，魏主喜曰：「非任城，朕事不成。」

translations.literal: Cheng returned and reported at Huatai; the Wei emperor said with delight: "Without Rencheng, my undertaking would not have succeeded."
translations.idiomatic: Cheng returned and reported at Huatai; the Wei emperor said with delight, "Without Rencheng, my undertaking would not have succeeded."

sentences.zh: 壬寅，尊皇太孫太妃為皇太后；

translations.literal: On renyin the imperial great-grandson's grand consort was honored as empress dowager;
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin the imperial great-grandson's grand consort was honored as empress dowager;

sentences.zh: 立妃為皇后。

translations.literal: the consort was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: and the consort was established as empress.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，魏主如鄴城。

translations.literal: On guimao the Wei emperor went to Ye City.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao the Wei emperor went to Ye City.

sentences.zh: 王肅見魏主於鄴，陳伐齊之策。

translations.literal: Wang Su met the Wei emperor at Ye and set forth a strategy for campaigning against Qi.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Su met the Wei emperor at Ye and set forth a strategy for campaigning against Qi.

sentences.zh: 魏主與之言，不覺促席移晷。

translations.literal: The Wei emperor spoke with him and, without noticing, drew his seat close and hours slipped by.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei emperor spoke with him and, without noticing, drew his seat close and hours slipped by.

sentences.zh: 自是器遇日隆，親舊貴臣莫能間也。

translations.literal: From then on his honors and favor daily increased, and none among the emperor's kin and great ministers could come between them.
translations.idiomatic: From then on his honors and favor daily increased, and none among the emperor's kin and great ministers could come between them.

sentences.zh: 魏主或屏左右與肅語，至夜分不罷，自謂君臣相得之晚。

translations.literal: The Wei emperor would sometimes dismiss his attendants and speak with Su until deep into the night, saying to himself that monarch and minister had found each other late.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei emperor would sometimes dismiss his attendants and speak with Su until deep into the night, saying to himself that monarch and minister had found each other late.

sentences.zh: 尋除輔國將軍、大將軍長史。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed General Who Assists the State and chief clerk to the Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed General Who Assists the State and chief clerk to the Grand General.

sentences.zh: 時魏主方議興禮樂，變華風，凡威儀文物，多肅所定。

translations.literal: At the time the Wei emperor was just then discussing reviving ritual and music and changing to civilized customs; nearly all ceremonial regalia and institutions were determined by Su.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the Wei emperor was discussing reviving ritual and music and changing to civilized customs; nearly all ceremonial regalia and institutions were determined by Su.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，魏主遣安定王休帥從官迎家於平城。

translations.literal: On yisi the Wei emperor sent Prince Xiu of Anding to lead the accompanying officials to bring the imperial household from Pingcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi the Wei emperor sent Prince Xiu of Anding to lead the accompanying officials to bring the imperial household from Pingcheng.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，封皇弟昭文為新安王，昭秀為臨海王，昭粲為永嘉王。

translations.literal: On xinhai the emperor's younger brothers Zhaowen, Zhaoxiu, and Zhaocan were enfeoffed as Prince of Xin'an, Prince of Linhai, and Prince of Yongjia respectively.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai the emperor's younger brothers Zhaowen, Zhaoxiu, and Zhaocan were enfeoffed as Prince of Xin'an, Prince of Linhai, and Prince of Yongjia respectively.

sentences.zh: 魏主築宮於鄴西，十一月，癸亥，徙居之。

translations.literal: The Wei emperor built a palace west of Ye; in the eleventh month, on guihai, he moved into it.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei emperor built a palace west of Ye; in the eleventh month, on the day guihai, he moved into it.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞江淹劾奏前益州刺史劉悛、梁州刺史陰智伯贓貨巨萬，皆抵罪。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Jiang Yan impeached the former Governor of Yi Province Liu Quan and Governor of Liang Province Yin Zhibo for accepting bribes worth tens of thousands; both were punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Jiang Yan impeached the former Governor of Yi Province Liu Quan and Governor of Liang Province Yin Zhibo for accepting bribes worth tens of thousands; both were punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 初，悛罷廣、司二州，傾貲以獻世祖，家無留儲。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Quan left his posts in Guang and Si provinces, he poured out his wealth as tribute to Emperor Shizu and left nothing in store at home.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Quan left his posts in Guang and Si provinces, he poured out his wealth as tribute to Emperor Shizu and left nothing in store at home.

sentences.zh: 在益州，作金浴盆，餘物稱是。

translations.literal: While in Yi Province he had a golden bathtub made, and his other possessions matched this in extravagance.
translations.idiomatic: While in Yi Province he had a golden bathtub made, and his other possessions matched this in extravagance.

sentences.zh: 及鬱林王即位，悛所獻減少。
